# dsh-reliability-guards

Guardrails for small local models in DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
Small models (7-35B on Ollama or simila

r) tend to claim success after a failed command, say they
checked something without calling a tool,

invent DOIs, or cut an answer in the middle. This plugin
catches those cases **before the user reads
the answer** and lets the model correct itself.
> **Maintenance:** best-effort. Issues may go unanswered; forks are welcome.
## What it does

When the turn is about to close, plain deterministic rules compare the final answer with what the
to

ols really returned. On a finding the model receives **one** steering notice in the same turn
(at mo

st 2 per turn, one per code) and rewrites its answer. What is still wrong at the end stays
visible u

ne per code) and rewrites its answer. What is still wrong at the end stays
visible under the answer.
| Code | Detected when |
| `falseSuccess` | the answer claims success, but a tool call failed (error, or shell `[exit code: N

]`) and was never made up for |
| `actionWithoutTool` | "I checked / I ran ..." with zero tool calls

in the turn |
| `announcedOnly` | an action is announced ("let me check:") and nothing is called |

| `deniedCapability` | "I can't access ..." while a fitting tool is in the request |
| `unverifiedDo
i` | a DOI in the answer appears in no tool result; the harness checks OpenAlex then Crossref and on

ly an unknown DOI triggers the notice (a network error never counts as invented) |
| `foreignScript`

| CJK characters the user did not write |
| `markupLeak` | a tool call written as text (`<tool_call

>`, `<function=...>`, `</think>`) |
| `cutAnswer` | the answer ends mid-sentence or with an unclosed

code block |
| `emoji` (off by default) | emojis the user did not write |
| `frenchSpelling` (off b
y default) | misspelled words, checked offline with `enchant-2` |
Rules are bilingual (English and French phrasing).
**Answer checks** (on the commands the answer gives the user):
| Code | Detected when |
| `codeWhileWaiting` | you asked to explain first and wait for your validation ("wait for my approva
l", "attends ma validation"...), and the answer contains code; the wait lasts until you give the go-

ahead ("go ahead", "je valide"...) |
| `unknownCommand` | a command in a shell block is not installe
d on this computer, is not installed by the answer itself, and appears in no tool result (an invente

d tool presented as real) |
| `untestedCommand` | after a turn with tools: a key, schema, path or op
tion value in a command appears in no tool result of the conversation; lines marked `# untested` (or

`# non testé`) pass |

## Configuration

Row `reliability-guards` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Every guard has an on/off switch:
`fa

lseSuccess`, `actionWithoutTool`, `announcedOnly`, `deniedCapability`, `unverifiedDoi`,
`cutAnswer`,

`foreignScript`, `emoji`, `frenchSpelling`, `codeWhileWaiting`, `unknownCommand`,
`untestedCommand`

, `shellMistake`, `sourcesDenied`, `answerRules` (the rules told before the answer),
`destructiveAsk
`, `tmpBackupDeny`, `explainMode`, `keepInvokedSkills`.
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `maxNudgesPerTurn` | 2 | steering notices per turn for the rules (the answer checks have 2 more) |

| `doiTimeoutMs` | 15000 | timeout of each DOI existence check |
| `spellAllow` | `[]` | extra word

s the spell check accepts |
| `explainAllow` | `[]` | extra tools allowed in `/explain` |
| `llmBody
TimeoutMinutes` | 0 | raise the HTTP body timeout for slow local models (0 = Node default, 5 min) |
## Compatibility
| Component | Supported |
ptional `peerDependencies` on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`, `@deepseek-ai/schema
stery` (`>=3.18.0 <4.0.0`) and `zod` (`>=4.0.0 <5.0.0`), the packages the plugin loads from the DSH

installation (`undici` is also tried, and skipped if absent) |
| Platform | Linux (tested); the plug
in itself is pure JavaScript with no native addon |
Tested with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` on Node 22.23 (see Verification).
## Permissions and external services
Everything the plugin can touch, and what happens when it fails:
| Capability | Where | Used for | If it fails |
| **Files (read only)** | `index.js` (`statSync`) | checks whether the target of `>` / `cp` / `mv` a
lready exists, so only an overwrite asks for approval | treated as "does not exist": no approval car

d |
| **Files (read only)** | `index.js` (`accessSync`, `statSync`) | answer checks: whether a progr
am named in an answer is installed (executable in a `PATH` folder, or in `/usr/sbin`, `/sbin`, `/sna
p/bin`, `/var/lib/flatpak/exports/bin`, `~/.local/bin`, `~/.cargo/bin`), and whether a file path nam
ed in a command of the answer exists. Only existence is checked; no file is opened or read | treated

as "not installed" / "does not exist": the model is asked to check it |
| **Memory** | `index.js` |
answer checks: the tool arguments and full tool results of each conversation (last ~400k characters
), so a name in an answer can be compared with what the tools really showed. In memory only, never w

ritten to disk, gone when DSH stops | n/a |
| **Files (write)** | none | the plugin writes nothing;

its state lives in the DSH session log | n/a |
| **Network** | `lib/doi.js` (`fetch`) | existence ch
eck of a DOI that appears in an answer but in no tool result, against `api.openalex.org` then `api.c
rossref.org`; nothing else is sent | a network error or timeout (`doiTimeoutMs`) never counts as an

invented DOI |
